hero.intro: Welcome to a hand-stitched galaxy where every plushie is a shooting star.

sections.about_text: I'm Mellumine, a polar vixen from the Stars. On Twitch I share cozy streams, my handmade plushies and my whole tiny galaxy. Aria, my mascot, follows me on every adventure.
sections.plushies_text: Every plushie is one of a kind, sewn with patience and love before joining a new family. Here's a glimpse of my creations.
sections.contact_text: Twitch, Discord, Instagram, TikTok… find me everywhere and come shine with me.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Welcome to my galaxy
about.intro: I'm Mellumine, a polar vixen who landed from a sparkling corner of the universe. My streams are gentle bubbles where we can breathe, laugh and craft together.
about.lore_text: Born under a shower of shooting stars, I came down to Earth to share my love for shiny things, animals and crafting. By night I gaze at the sky; by day I sew dream companions.
about.aria_text: Aria is my adventure buddy, a small luminous spirit who watches over the community and joins me in every stream.

meta.content: Discover Mellumine's handmade plushie collection, each one stitched with love, star by star.

plushies.title: My plushies
plushies.subtitle: Hand-stitched, star by star
plushies.intro: Each plushie is designed, cut and sewn by my own paws. None of them is exactly the same — they are tiny textile shooting stars.

meta.content: Find Mellumine on Twitch, Discord, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X. Join her galaxy and support her creations.
